The statement requires a contractible relative handle complex. A presentation with exactly one total relative handle would have one nonzero free module and zero differential, so it cannot meet the homotopy-equivalence hypothesis. A single cancelling pair, one handle in each of two adjacent degrees, is allowed and has unit differential.
